correctness.rationale: Constructed the 16 lexicographically ordered stable triples of Z/8 directly, all 36 disjointness edges of SG_{3,2}, and independently enumerated every one of 2^16 masks. Obtained f(Ind)=(16,84,184,186,88,16), f(N)=(16,68,88,42,8), with N⊂Ind and 352 non-neighborhood faces. Independently expanded all 14 quoted free-face/coface mask representatives into their D8 orbits, of sizes (8,8,16,16,8,16,8,16,16,16,8,16,8,16). In each CURRENT complex every lower simplex is a codimension-1 face of its uniquely remaining upper coface, every orbit has pairwise disjoint face pairs and leaves N untouched, and each remaining face set is invariant under all 16 symmetries. Total 176 pair removals delete all 352 faces, terminating mask-for-mask at N. Independently computed signed simplex Lefschetz sums for all 16 D8 elements on both complexes; both agree and yield trace-1=(-1)^(a+b) on H2 when combined with the previously known sphere homotopy type. These are exhaustively finite checks for ONE 16-vertex graph, not extrapolation to arbitrary Schrijver parameters. Independent checker reconstructed from definitions and published representative masks, not only read saved verification output.

An exhaustive equivariant relative simplicial collapse is a strong and independently useful finite structural witness: it establishes a specific simple-homotopy equivalence and orientation character for the smallest nontrivial Schrijver example. The result is narrowly graph-specific but mathematically motivated; no broader SG_{n,2} theorem is claimed.
